representation_fit.evidence: Relational-web rendered with relationships as first-class content: 35-node/56-edge SVG dependency map in 4 layered bands (screenshots/1280x860.png and 1440x900.png; data.js:3, BANDS app.js:12-17); edges are clickable objects with a dedicated 关系详情 panel including a blast-radius sentence (app.js:420-442); direction semantics 依赖(blue)/影响(orange) with legend (index.html:73-77, styles.css:189-190); sidebar lists 它依赖/被谁依赖 per node (app.js:416-417) — matches the brief's many/high-relationality/medium-hierarchy facets and suggested primary object 'relationship'.

primary_task_salience.evidence: Understand-and-follow dominates the initial screen: the graph occupies ~3/4 width, the app boots already in a follow state on 订单服务 with blue/orange highlighted edges and per-edge labels (订单计价/锁定库存/下单风控…) visible in both screenshots (app.js:769 comment 首屏即处于跟随态); follow controls 依赖/双向/影响 and 1跳/2跳/3跳/闭包 plus hint 点击节点跟随依赖与影响 sit in the top bar (index.html:31-41,79); the sidebar leads with 它依赖 · 6 and 被谁依赖 · 1 follow rows (1280x860.png).

time_to_understand.evidence: Model-judged proxy per rubric label: first paint conveys what/where immediately — title/subtitle 脉络 Trace · 青梧电商平台 · 依赖关系跟随 (index.html:19-20), stats 35节点/56关系/4层带, band labels 接入层/业务服务层/消息总线/数据与外部 (app.js:12-17), bottom legend for node shapes/relation kinds/direction (index.html:58-78), and a pre-selected node card with a domain description; no loading state (app boot flag app.js:770).

navigation_cost.evidence: Single screen, no modes/routes: primary object reachable in 1 click on the always-visible graph (app.js:612-622) or via sidebar follow rows / hub ranking / trail chips (app.js:648-674); search-to-jump in one query (app.js:714-743); path analysis = one button then pick two nodes (app.js:576-589, 690-701); deep-link hash restores a view (app.js:746-764).

context_loss.evidence: Directly engineers the acceptance seed: focusing dims rather than removes (app.js:327; styles.css:208 .edge.dim, 217 .node.dim opacity .24; comment app.js:306 全景素净); permanent 跟随轨迹 breadcrumb with numbered chips and hop-kind labels (index.html:47-52 永不丢失全局上下文; app.js:554-571; visible as ① 订单服务 in both screenshots); coverage counter 已走访 1/35 (app.js:567-570); click-empty returns to overview (app.js:617-621); layout is computed once so following never reflows the web (app.js:148).

ui_surface_complexity.evidence: Permanent surfaces: topbar (brand, 3 stats, coverage meter, search, 2 segmented controls, path/reset), trailbar, graph+legend+hint, sidebar — every control serves the follow job, no modals or dead chrome (index.html:13-86). Slightly control-dense at 1280x860 (search narrowed to 190px, styles.css:78), though nothing collides in either viewport; richness is proportionate to a many-node high-relationality task, not minimal.

accessibility.evidence: Positive: semantic <button> for list/segment/trail controls (app.js:367; index.html:31-43), aria-label on control groups and the svg (index.html:31,36,57), search focus style (styles.css:84). Gaps: the primary SVG graph is mouse-only — click handlers with no tabindex/role/keyboard path (app.js:612-645), so keyboard users reach nodes only via search/sidebar; small targets (26px seg buttons styles.css:104, 28px act-btn styles.css:316, 26px trail chips styles.css:134); line direction encoded by color alone on identical solid strokes (styles.css:209-210); dimmed nodes at opacity .24 are very low contrast by design (styles.css:217). Receipt a11y.contrast/a11y.focus_order/a11y.target_size all 'skipped' with target_invalid:true (measurement-summary.json:13-15,18), so no objective verification.

frontend_rework.evidence: No visible layout defects at either viewport: 1280x860 and 1440x900 show intact topbar, legend, sidebar cards, labeled edges, no overlap or truncation; on-screen sidebar figures reconcile exactly with data.js (它依赖 6 = edges data.js:102-107; 被谁依赖 1 = data.js:74; 依赖闭包 20 / 影响闭包 4 / 影响链深 2 match graph traversal), indicating the engine renders real consistent data. But all receipt checks including layout.overflow/responsive_collision/text.truncation are 'skipped' with target_invalid:true (measurement-summary.json:10-18), so zero-defect status is unverified rather than demonstrated.

acceptance_seed_coverage.evidence: Seed 关系跟随不丢失全局上下文 is addressed structurally, not just cosmetically: in-place dim-don't-hide focus keeps the full web visible while following (app.js:317-354; styles.css:208,217); permanent revisitable numbered trail chips with hop kinds (app.js:554-571, back-handler app.js:666-673); visited-coverage meter (app.js:567-570); edge-as-content detail preserving relation context (app.js:436 若…不可用…波及 N 个节点); hint states 图谱始终保持全景 · 点击空白回到总览 (index.html:79); deep link preserves sel/dir/depth (app.js:746-751).

defects_observed: SVG graph — the primary object — is mouse-only: nodes/edges have click handlers but no tabindex/role/keyboard activation (app.js:612-645); keyboard access exists only indirectly via search (app.js:732-738) or sidebar lists

关系详情 (edge detail) is reachable only by clicking the line itself (app.js:599-602,615-616); sidebar relation rows record the edge but select the node (app.js:592-596), so edge-as-content lacks a keyboard-equivalent path
Interactive targets below common guidance: 26px segmented buttons (styles.css:104), 28px action buttons (styles.css:316), 26px trail chips (styles.css:134)
Edge direction (依赖 vs 影响) is color-only on identical solid strokes (styles.css:209-210); mitigated by legend and textual labels in lists but not by shape/dash on the graph itself
Panel HTML is built via innerHTML with esc() as identity (app.js:358) — safe only because data is local/static; latent injection hazard, not a visible defect
missing_evidence: All seven receipt checks are 'skipped' with target_invalid=true (measurement-summary.json:10-18): no objective evidence for layout.overflow, layout.responsive_collision, text.truncation, a11y.contrast, a11y.focus_order, a11y.target_size, type.min_projected_size
No runtime evidence that the built-in selftest (?selftest=1, app.js:774-821) was ever executed or passed
scores.overall_note: A single-screen static SPA (root index.html + data.js/app.js/styles.css) that satisfies the delivery constraints: usable at first paint with local data and a pre-selected node (app.js:767-770; both screenshots show a fully loaded follow state at 1280x860 and 1440x900). Representation fits the brief's relational-web shape tightly — relationships are first-class clickable objects with a dedicated detail panel and blast-radius statement (app.js:420-442), direction/depth are one-click controls, and the acceptance seed 跟随不丢失全局上下文 is engineered via dim-don't-hide focus, a permanent numbered trail bar, and a visited-coverage meter. On-screen sidebar figures reconcile exactly with data.js edges, and no layout defects are visible at either viewport. The notable weaknesses are verification and accessibility: the measurement receipt is invalid so all seven checks (layout, truncation, a11y) were skipped and provide no objective signal, and the SVG graph itself — the primary object — is mouse-only with 26-28px targets and color-only direction encoding, leaving accessibility resting on the secondary list/search surfaces. Per the rubric, time_to_understand is a model-judged proxy, and task completion time, retrieval accuracy, and human preference are not observable in this blind review.
